summary: Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka on the Donetsk front while Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bomb strikes against Dnipropetrovsk, Kharkiv, Donetsk and Zaporizhzhia oblasts. Three Tu-95MS strategic bombers redeployed from the Far East to Olenya airfield armed with cruise missiles, indicating preparation for a massed missile strike. A US delegation including Witkoff and Kushner departed Kyiv by train after a second round of talks with Zelensky, with European representatives joining future discussions.

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces advanced near Kostyantynivka on the Donetsk front while Russian tactical aviation conducted guided bomb attacks on multiple oblasts. Three Tu-95MS strategic bombers redeployed to Olenya airfield armed with cruise missiles, signaling preparation for a massed missile strike. A US delegation including Witkoff and Kushner completed a second round of talks in Kyiv and departed by train, with European representatives expected to join future negotiations.

points:
Ukraine is considering legalizing the pornography industry to supplement its military budget, potentially generating approximately $25 million annually that could fund roughly 30,000 drones, according to WSJ. Production or storage of pornography currently carries up to 7 years imprisonment in Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/83924)

Deputy head of the International Cooperation Department of the Office of the Prosecutor General Serhii Kropyva was taken into custody in the "Carthage" case with alternative bail set at 120 million hryvnias. (Source: @UkraineNow/83931)

Zelensky held face-to-face talks with Witkoff and Kushner and presented them with T-shirts bearing the inscription "Kyiv Regime," according to media reports. Ukrainian airports were reportedly ready but Russians did not permit American delegation aircraft to land. (Source: @UkraineNow/83921)

Putin and Aliyev discussed trade, economic and humanitarian cooperation by phone, agreeing to intensify bilateral contacts at various levels. (Source: @tass_agency/394172)

sections.threat_assessment: Russian strategic aviation posture with three Tu-95MS bombers redeployed to Olenya airfield armed with cruise missiles indicates imminent threat of massed missile strike against Ukrainian infrastructure. Combined with ballistic missile launch warnings from Kursk oblast and active tactical aviation conducting guided bomb strikes across four oblasts, the air threat level is elevated. Ground operations show continued Russian pressure on the Donetsk axis with advances near Kostyantynivka and envelopment operations on the Slavyansk-Krasnolyman direction.
sections.regional_response: Russia issued formal protest through Zakharova against US deployment of medium and shorter-range missile complexes in Norway, declaring it nullifies strategic stability dialogue prerequisites. Putin-Aliyev phone call demonstrated continued Russia-Azerbaijan cooperation coordination. European defense industry was criticized for 5-10 year program timelines that risk obsolescence before completion according to Euractiv reporting. The Witkoff-Kushner delegation departure by train rather than air due to Russian denial of airport access highlights operational friction in diplomatic logistics.
sections.intelligence_notes: Drone activity patterns show concentrated strikes on Sumy, Chernihiv, Dnipropetrovsk and Kharkiv oblasts with multiple rocket UAV tracks recorded across northern and eastern directions. The combination of Tu-95MS redeployment, ballistic missile threat warnings and active tactical aviation suggests a coordinated multi-axis strike preparation. Chinese request for restraint regarding Vladivostok during Eastern Economic Forum indicates diplomatic coordination between Kyiv and Beijing, with Ukraine pledging non-attack. Russian forces reportedly covered Ukrainian grouping on Slavyansk-Krasnolyman direction from northern and eastern sections per Pushilin.
